 1   Mr. President.  

 2                Mr. President, at this time could 

 3   you please call on Senator Espaillat for the 

 4   purposes of an introduction, please.

 5                ACTING PRESIDENT O'MARA:   Senator 

 6   Espaillat.

 7                SENATOR ESPAILLAT:   Thank you, 

 8   Mr. President.

 9                We have a distinguished delegation 

10   here today, a delegation from the Coalition in 

11   Support of Russian American History Month.  This 

12   delegation is headed by Olga Zatsepina; Father 

13   Alexander, who we just heard give the 

14   invocation; Julio Rodriguez; Michael Angelo 

15   Mutlu; Tatania Deptola; and Irina 

16   Shteynvurtsel.  

17                And this delegation proposes to 

18   engage the Legislature in making sure that April 

19   becomes and is proclaimed by the Governor as 

20   Russian American History Month in the State of 

21   New York.  And that month has been chosen 

22   because many great things have occurred during 

23   the month of April for the Russian American 

24   community and for Americans in general.

25                Four hundred years ago, in April, 


                                                                674

 1   was the founding of the Romanov dynasty.  Also, 

 2   this year is the half-century anniversary of the 

 3   space flight of the first woman cosmonaut, 

 4   Valentina Tereshkova, and also the 120th year of 

 5   the birth of the great Russian and Soviet poet, 

 6   Vladimir Mayakovsky.  

 7                So this is an important month for 

 8   the Russian American community, and they are here 

 9   and this is their second year that they have 

10   visited the Legislature.  And we have a 

11   resolution in support of April being proclaimed 

12   Russian American History Month.  

13                So we thank them for coming up.  

14   Once again, we hope you come up every year.  And 

15   we look forward to the festival that they have 

16   every April.  This year it will be on 96th Street 

17   and Broadway, Senator Perkins, right on the 

18   borderline of both of our districts.  

19                So I invite you to participate with 

20   this community in friendship, and I welcome you 

21   to Albany.  Thank you so much.

22                (Applause.)

23                ACTING PRESIDENT O'MARA:   Thank 

24   you, Senator Espaillat, and welcome to our guests 

25   here today.  Thank you for being with us.

24                THE SECRETARY:   Legislative 

25   Resolution Number 603, by Senator Klein, 


                                                                676

 1   commending Police Officer Frank G. Misa and 

 2   Police Officer Mitchell J. Richter in recognition 

 3   of their heroic actions in saving the life of a 

 4   drowning woman.  

 5                "WHEREAS, Citizens across our state 

 6   and nation are inspired by and indebted to our 

 7   noble police officers who exhibit courage and 

 8   bravery every day in the course of their duties; 

 9   and 

10                "WHEREAS, It is the custom of this 

11   Legislative Body to recognize and commend the 

12   caring concern and heroic acts of individuals who 

13   take prompt and appropriate action in emergency 

14   situations, nobly risking their own lives in an 

15   effort to preserve the life of another; and 

16                "WHEREAS, Attendant to such concern, 

17   and in full accord with its long-standing  

18   traditions, this Legislative Body is justly proud 

19   to commend Police Officer Frank G. Misa and 

20   Police Officer Mitchell J. Richter in recognition 

21   of their heroic actions in saving the life of a 

22   drowning woman; and 

23                "WHEREAS, On the morning of 

24   Thursday, February 7, 2013, Police Officer Frank 

25   G. Misa and Police Officer Mitchell J. Richter of 


                                                                677

 1   the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey 

 2   were onboard Marine Patrol Vessel 7200 performing  

 3   routine perimeter checks of LaGuardia Airport and 

 4   monitoring police radio; and 

 5                "WHEREAS, A call came over the radio 

 6   stating a woman attempted to take her life and 

 7   jumped off the Whitestone Bridge.  Being  within  

 8   close proximity, Police Officer Frank G. Misa and 

 9   Police Officer Mitchell J. Richter were on the 

10   scene within three minutes and immediately  

11   observed the victim in the water; and 

12                "WHEREAS, Due to the quick and 

13   astute actions of Police Officer Frank G. Misa 

14   and Police Officer Mitchell J. Richter, the 

15   victim was pulled from the frigid water and 

16   received first aid.  She was kept warm with a 

17   blanket and brought to safety; and 

18                "WHEREAS, Police Officers Frank G. 

19   Misa and Mitchell J. Richter displayed exemplary 

20   professionalism in the performance of their  

21   duties by responding immediately to a person in 

22   need and ultimately saving her life; and 

23                "WHEREAS, It is the sense of this 

24   Legislative Body that those who enhance the 

25   quality of life in their community and have shown 


                                                                678

 1   a sustained commitment to the maintenance of high  

 2   standards in their profession, certainly have 

 3   earned the recognition and applause of all the 

 4   citizens of this great Empire State; now, 

 5   therefore, be it 

 6                "RESOLVED, That this Legislative 

 7   Body pause in its deliberations to commend Police  

 8   Officer Frank G. Misa and Police Officer Mitchell 

 9   J. Richter in recognition of their heroic actions 

10   in saving the life of a drowning woman; and be it 

11   further 

12                "RESOLVED, That copies of this 

13   resolution, suitably engrossed, be transmitted to 

14   Police Officer Frank G. Misa and Police Officer  

15   Mitchell J. Richter."

16                ACTING PRESIDENT O'MARA:   This 

17   resolution was previously adopted on February 28, 

18   2013.

19                Senator Klein on the resolution.

20                SENATOR KLEIN:   Thank you, 

21   Mr. President.  

22                I want to thank you for taking time 

23   out of our legislative business to recognize two 

24   outstanding officers, Port Authority Officer 

25   Mitchell Richter and Port Authority Officer Frank 


                                                                679

 1   Misa.  

 2                I also want to take an opportunity 

 3   to welcome Officer Richter's wonderful wife, 

 4   Lisa, who is with us today, as well as their two 

 5   children, Madelyn and Andrew.  

 6                I also want to recognize Officer 

 7   Misa's uncle, Robert Reid, who is joining us in 

 8   the Senate as well.  

 9                I know how it was read into the 

10   record that these two young men are some of our 

11   finest in the Port Authority.  And I think it's 

12   time for us to sort of recognize that each and 

13   every day there's first responders that are 

14   risking their life performing heroic acts that 

15   sometimes just go unnoticed.  

16                So I'm glad we have the opportunity 

17   today to have these two fine officers, who I 

18   think are setting a very important example of the 

19   heroic acts that we sometimes overlook in 

20   everyday life by people in law enforcement.  I 

21   think they really are showing us what public 

22   service is all about:  Why people enter the 

23   police force, why people decide to be 

24   firefighters, why people decide to put their 

25   lives on the line each and every day.  


                                                                680

 1                So I want to say a very special 

 2   thank you.  I know the families are very, very 

 3   proud of you.  And again, I know you're going to 

 4   inspire a lot of young people because of your 

 5   heroic acts, who now may choose the wonderful 

 6   profession of law enforcement.  

 7                So thank you all very, very much.

 8                ACTING PRESIDENT O'MARA:   Thank 

 9   you, Senator Klein.

10                Senator Hannon on the resolution.

11                SENATOR HANNON:   Thank you, 

12   Mr. President.

13                I want to commend Frank and Mitch 

14   for their acts.  I want to commend Senator Klein 

15   for recognizing what they have done.  

16                I think that it's very important 

17   that when people have gone out of their way, 

18   risked their own lives -- I mean, frankly, the 

19   waters under the Whitestone Bridge in February 

20   are probably the most treacherous and frozen that 

21   I can think of except for perhaps up in one of 

22   the lakes.  

23                But recognizing when people go out 

24   of their way, inspiring others, the height of 

25   service, it's very appropriate for this chamber 


                                                                681

 1   to recognize them.  I'm glad they've been able to 

 2   join with us, and I'm glad we're able to take the 

 3   time to say thank you on behalf of all the 

 4   citizens of New York.

 5                ACTING PRESIDENT O'MARA:   Thank 

 6   you, Senator Hannon.

 7                And congratulations to you, 

 8   Officers.  Thank you for your courageousness and 

 9   heroism and your efforts in your everyday 

10   performance of your duties, going above and 

11   beyond.  

12                Welcome here in the Senate.  Enjoy 

13   your stay with us today, and thank you for being 

14   here.

16   Rivera to explain your vote.  

17                SENATOR RIVERA:   Thank you, 

18   Mr. President, to explain my vote.  

19                This is a bill that we have 

20   considered on the floor before, and it is 

21   regarding when a person knowingly harbors, houses 

22   or employs a defaulting sex offender.  

23                There are many sex offender bills 

24   that we've considered on the floor; I've spoken 

25   about them previously.  While I certainly believe 


                                                                686

 1   that for the most dangerous sex offenders, 

 2   Level 3 sex offenders, we need to make sure that 

 3   we can keep them from folks in our communities 

 4   and we need to make sure that we are safe from 

 5   them, this bill makes no distinction.  

 6                There's Level 1 and Level 2 sex 

 7   offenders that are included in this bill, and I 

 8   believe that for that reason it is a bill that is 

 9   too broad and it places a big burden on families 

10   or renters.  

11                And again, while I believe that we 

12   certainly need to do everything that we can to 

13   keep our families and communities safe from sex 

14   offenders, there is a need to distinguish between 

15   different levels.  In this case, no such 

16   distinction is made, so I will be voting in the 

17   negative.  

18                Thank you, Mr. President.
